mapper.select: select * from sys_user_webauthn_credential where user_id = #{userId} and status = '0' order by credential_record_id desc
select * from sys_user_webauthn_credential where credential_id = #{credentialId} and status = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user_webauthn_credential (user_id, credential_id, credential_name, public_key, algorithm, sign_count, aaguid, transports, user_handle, browser_name, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{credentialId}, #{credentialName}, #{publicKey}, #{algorithm}, #{signCount}, #{aaguid}, #{transports}, #{userHandle}, #{browserName}, '0', sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update sys_user_webauthn_credential set sign_count = #{signCount}, last_used_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where credential_record_id = #{credentialRecordId} and status = '0'
